viralPatterns.description: Videos that immediately show a striking visual or bold text statement, then reveal the process or journey. High completion rate due to curiosity gap created in the first second.
Posts that challenge common assumptions with original data or analysis. Gets upvoted for novelty and sparks debate in comments.
examples: Why the conventional wisdom about X is wrong

hookAnalysis.description: Opening with an intriguing statement or visual that creates an information gap viewers must watch to resolve.
Opening with a bold opinion that challenges subreddit consensus, compelling readers to engage in debate.
examples: Hot take: X is overrated because...

hookAnalysis.description: Opening carousel slide that names a specific frustration the audience relates to immediately.
examples: POV: You just spent 4 hours on something that takes 10 minutes

captionStyles.description: Opening with a personal anecdote (2-3 sentences) before delivering the value proposition. Uses first-person voice and conversational tone.
captionStyles.engagementImpact: High save rate due to relatable storytelling combined with actionable advice

captionStyles.description: Short, punchy text overlays that drive the narrative. No spoken caption — the text IS the caption.
captionStyles.engagementImpact: Increases completion rate because viewers must read each frame

timingInsights.rationale: TikTok engagement peaks during morning scroll and evening entertainment windows. Tuesday and Thursday show highest FYP distribution rates.
Reddit's Hot algorithm rewards early engagement velocity. Morning posts have more hours to accumulate upvotes before evening decline.

recommendations: Focus on hook-driven short-form video content on TikTok with transformation reveals and curiosity gaps. For Reddit, invest in data-driven original analysis posts that spark debate. On Instagram, use carousel format with micro-storytelling captions and the 3-5-2 hashtag stack. Post TikTok content Tuesday/Thursday evenings and Reddit content Tuesday-Thursday mornings ET.
